bio: Hello! I’m a sixth-year resident tutor, and proud Lowell alum (‘14), and am currently studying human development and psychology at HGSE. Originally from suburban Philadelphia, I’ve also lived in Austin and traveled extensively in the US and abroad. As an undergrad, I studied History and Science, and my interests lie at the intersection of youth, psychology, and education. I enjoy spending time outdoors, drinking lots of tea, playing fetch with my dog Scout, and discussing Britney Spears. I'm looking forward to chatting and getting to know you via your choice of virtual backgrounds! Community Lowell House Role Residential
